title: Calendars & leap years
examples: How many days are in February during a leap year?
If today is the tenth of a month, what date will it be in three weeks?
What is the rule for figuring out if a year is a leap year?

explain.say: Today we are learning about calendars and leap years. Do you know how many months are in a year?
Some months have thirty days, and some months have thirty-one days. Remember that February is special.
Most months have thirty or thirty-one days. For example, March has thirty-one days. This helps us count correctly.
A leap year adds an extra day to February. This happens every four years. For instance, the year two thousand twenty four is a leap year.

When you plan a long trip, you must check the dates carefully. If you forget the leap year rule, you might plan to return a day too early or too late. This shows why calendars are important for planning.
A common mistake is thinking every year has an extra day in February. Remember that leap years only happen every four years, not every year. You must check the year number to know for sure.

draw.text: Leap years happen every four years.

faq.q: How do I know if a year is a leap year?
faq.a: You check if the year number is easily divided by four. If it is, it is usually a leap year. You can also ask if it is divisible by four hundred.
asks: Is there a trick for leap years?
What is the leap year rule?

faq.q: Why do we need leap years?
faq.a: The Earth takes about 365 and a quarter days to orbit the sun. The extra day keeps our calendar matching the seasons.
asks: Does the Earth's orbit affect the calendar?

faq.q: How many days are in February normally?
faq.a: In a regular year, February has exactly twenty-eight days. It is the shortest month in the calendar.
asks: Does February always have twenty-eight days?
What is the standard number of days in February?

faq.q: If I count three weeks from today, what do I do?
faq.a: You simply add twenty-one days to today's date. Three weeks is exactly three times seven days.
asks: How many days are in three weeks?
If I add three weeks, what date is it?

faq.q: Which month has exactly thirty days?
faq.a: The month of June has exactly thirty days. It is one of the months that does not have thirty-one days.
asks: Tell me a month with thirty days.

facts: There are twelve months in a year.
February has twenty-eight days in a common year.
A leap year adds one extra day to February.
Leap years usually occur every four years.

quiz.say: How many days are in a non-leap year February?
quiz.why: In a normal year, February always has twenty-eight days.

wrong.0: This is wrong because only a few months have thirty days.
wrong.1: This is wrong because we only count up to thirty-one days.
wrong.3: This is wrong because twenty-nine only happens in a leap year.

quiz.say: If today is the tenth of a month, what date is it in three weeks?
quiz.why: Three weeks is the same as adding twenty-one days to the current date.

wrong.1: This is wrong because three weeks is much longer than just three days.
wrong.2: This is wrong because three weeks is not the same as thirty days.
wrong.3: This is wrong because seven days is only one week, not three.
